PullRequest.Title: Remove the phase plan line from the HydraFusion workflow milestone
PullRequest.Body:
Follow-up to #337096.

The "Selected <pattern> workflow" milestone already says what the workflow will do, so the extra phase-plan line after it (e.g. "First pass → Critique pass → Revision pass (if needed)") just repeated that. This removes it. The milestone now shows only the title and the one-line description.

The pass names still appear as the per-phase labels while each phase runs.

**Tests**
- Updated the `CopilotFusionProgress` description test. It now feeds a resolved event that includes a phase plan and checks the plan isn't shown. Before, it passed `phasePlan: undefined`, so it couldn't catch this.

Scenarios.Scenario: Live HydraFusion workflow selection milestone during an active chat turn
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The SDK delivers one `session.fusion_resolved` event, `_acceptFusionEvent` synchronously calls `CopilotFusionProgress.accept`, constructs the milestone Markdown, and `_emitFusionProgress` emits one `ChatResponsePart` action before the selected-workflow milestone can appear. The diff removes phase-plan map/localize/join work and shortens that action payload; it adds no work to this path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Receive the SDK `session.fusion_resolved` event from the Copilot runtime.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One effective event per unique workflow resolution after `_record` deduplication.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same resolution event was received and processed once.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The inbound event initiates milestone creation, but the diff neither adds nor moves this network boundary.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Emit one `ChatResponsePart` action containing the selected-workflow Markdown to the chat consumer.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One action per accepted unique fusion resolution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single action was emitted with the description plus a formatted phase-plan line.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: This action is required for the milestone to become visible. The diff keeps the same call count and sends fewer Markdown bytes because the phase-plan line is omitted.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One accepted resolution per workflow/fusion ID. `_record(route:<fusionId>)` suppresses duplicates, and realistic phase plans contain the workflow's small fixed set of phases (the fixture has three).
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Fusion events are handled synchronously through the event listener; there is no changed parallelism, queue, limiter, or fan-out. Duplicate resolution events are coalesced by the progress object's milestone set.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: There is no external data cache on this path. The in-memory `_milestones` set is the deduplication state; cold first delivery emits the milestone, while repeated delivery for the same fusion ID performs no milestone construction or transport. The diff does not alter invalidation or negative-cache behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed hunk, deduplication guard, synchronous caller, and unchanged action emission are directly visible in the traced code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact Markdown serialization and rendering savings depend on locale and plan length, but the direction is strictly reduced work and the plan cardinality is small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The production change eliminates bounded formatting/allocation work and reduces the existing action payload and rendered content without increasing frequency, retention, or boundary calls.

Scenarios.Scenario: Cold and warm reconstruction of persisted chat history containing HydraFusion workflows
Scenarios.CriticalPath: On a cold reconstruction, `_computeMappedEvents` pages the persisted event log, then `mapSessionEvents` walks the event array and `FusionReplayState.observe` calls `CopilotFusionProgress.accept` for each Fusion event before reconstructed turns are returned. On a warm request, `_mappedEventsMemo` reuses the reconstruction promise/result. The diff removes phase-plan formatting for each accepted persisted resolution and therefore shortens, rather than lengthens, the cold critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read persisted SDK event-log pages through `rpc.eventLog.read`.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One sequential RPC per page of up to 1000 events, approximately ceil(N/1000) on a cold reconstruction; zero additional reads for a warm memoized reconstruction.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical pagination and call count before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Cold reconstruction waits for all pages before mapping. The changed milestone formatting occurs only afterward and does not introduce or increase these RPCs.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Batch-load stored file-edit records with `db.getFileEdits(editToolCallIds)` when edit calls exist.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one batched database call per cold mapping, independent of the number of Fusion phase-plan entries.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same optional single batch read occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The batch can delay cold history mapping, but it is unrelated to the changed Fusion milestone content and its placement/cardinality are unchanged.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Total persisted session events N, with F accepted `session.fusion_resolved` events after turn ownership and per-turn milestone deduplication. The removed work previously scaled with the sum of phase-plan lengths across F workflows; the changed code performs none of that work.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Event-log pages are fetched sequentially by cursor and replay is serial over the event array. File-edit metadata is fetched once as a batch. The diff changes neither concurrency nor backpressure.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: `_mappedEventsMemo` coalesces concurrent reconstruction and serves warm requests per agent scope; rejected reconstructions are evicted for retry. During replay, progress state deduplicates milestones and resets at turn boundaries. The diff does not alter these cache keys, lifetimes, or miss behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the memoization, paginated RPC loop, batched database read, serial replay, and changed milestone construction are directly traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Session history size and number of Fusion workflows vary, but every affected resolution now allocates and serializes less content; no plausible input reverses that direction.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Cold replay does less per-workflow string work and retains smaller response parts; warm-cache behavior and all expensive-boundary cardinalities are unchanged.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the full two-file diff. The only production change removes a bounded phase-plan map/localization/join and its Markdown payload from live and replayed workflow milestones. No expensive boundary, fan-out, synchronous UI work, cache lifecycle, concurrency, or retention regression is introduced, and there is no evidenced shipped performance symptom warranting a regression-fix record.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
